mount-entoto-viewpoint-tour.title: Mount Entoto Viewpoint Tour
mount-entoto-viewpoint-tour.summary: Rise above the capital for panoramic views, historic churches, and cool highland air on Mount Entoto.
mount-entoto-viewpoint-tour.description: Mount Entoto is where Addis Ababa’s story begins. With Mesfin Shumet Tour and Travel, you’ll drive up through eucalyptus forests to sweeping viewpoints over Ethiopia’s capital, visit landmark churches, and learn how this mountain shaped the city’s founding. Ideal for first-time visitors who want photos, history, and fresh air in one half-day.
highlights: Entoto Maryam church & local history stories
Cool highland climate and forest walks
Guided by a local Addis expert

itinerary.text: Pickup from your hotel and scenic drive up Mount Entoto.
Viewpoint stops, church visit, and photo time above the city.
Optional short forest walk, then return to Addis.

faqs.a: Comfortable shoes and a light jacket — Entoto is cooler than downtown Addis.
Yes. The pace is flexible and viewpoints are easy to enjoy with kids.
Absolutely. Tell us what you care about most and we will shape the route.

unity-park-imperial-palace.title: Unity Park & Imperial Palace
unity-park-imperial-palace.summary: Explore imperial palace grounds, museums, gardens, and wildlife in the heart of Addis Ababa.
unity-park-imperial-palace.description: Unity Park sits inside the former imperial palace compound — a calm green escape with museums, gardens, and animal enclosures. Your Mesfin Shumet guide helps you navigate tickets, highlights, and the stories behind Ethiopia’s modern history.

itinerary.text: Hotel pickup and entry to Unity Park.
Guided walk through key palace, museum, and garden areas.
Optional café stop nearby, then hotel drop-off.

faqs.a: Entrance fees are paid on site; we help with the process and timing.

faqs.q: How long does the visit take?
faqs.a: Most guests enjoy 3–4 hours inside the park.

national-museum-lucy-tour.title: National Museum & Lucy Tour
national-museum-lucy-tour.summary: Meet Lucy and explore Ethiopia’s archaeological and royal heritage at the National Museum.
national-museum-lucy-tour.description: The National Museum of Ethiopia is home to Lucy (Dinkinesh) and collections that span ancient history to imperial artifacts. This focused tour is perfect if you want culture without rushing the whole city.

itinerary.text: Pickup and arrival at the National Museum.
Guided highlights including Lucy and key galleries.
Return transfer or continue to another stop.

faqs.a: Rules vary by gallery; your guide will advise on site.

merkato-market-experience.title: Merkato Market Experience
merkato-market-experience.summary: Navigate Africa’s largest open-air market with a local guide — spices, crafts, and city energy.
merkato-market-experience.description: Merkato is vibrant, vast, and best explored with someone who knows the lanes. We’ll help you see spice stalls, textiles, and everyday Addis life at a comfortable pace.

itinerary.text: Pickup and orientation before entering Merkato.
Guided walk through selected market sections.
Optional coffee stop and return transfer.

faqs.a: With a local guide and sensible belongings, most guests have a great visit.

holy-trinity-cathedral-visit.title: Holy Trinity Cathedral Visit
holy-trinity-cathedral-visit.summary: Visit one of Ethiopia’s most important churches and learn its imperial and religious stories.
holy-trinity-cathedral-visit.description: Holy Trinity Cathedral is a landmark of faith and history in Addis Ababa. Your guide shares context on architecture, imperial tombs, and respectful visiting customs.

itinerary.text: Guided cathedral visit with time for photos outside.
Optional nearby culture stop or hotel return.

faqs.a: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is recommended.

entoto-park-nature-escape.title: Entoto Park Nature Escape
entoto-park-nature-escape.summary: Fresh air, forest paths, and mountain calm at Entoto Park above Addis Ababa.
entoto-park-nature-escape.description: Entoto Park is a nature break from downtown traffic — open space, views, and a slower rhythm. Perfect for families and anyone who wants outdoors with easy logistics.
highlights: Great for photos and fresh air

itinerary.text: Scenic ascent toward Entoto.
Guided time for views and walking.
Descent back to your hotel.

faqs.q: Is this different from the viewpoint tour?
faqs.a: Yes — this focuses more on park time and nature, while the viewpoint tour emphasizes historic Entoto overlooks.

full-day-addis-ababa-city-tour.title: Full Day Addis Ababa City Tour
full-day-addis-ababa-city-tour.summary: The classic Addis day: Entoto views, museums, landmarks, and local flavor in one itinerary.
full-day-addis-ababa-city-tour.description: See the best of Addis Ababa in a single day with Mesfin Shumet Tour and Travel. We balance viewpoints, culture, and markets so you leave with a real sense of the capital — not just a checklist.

itinerary.text: Entoto viewpoint and city panorama.
Museum or cathedral visit and lunch stop.
Merkato or Unity Park depending on your interests.

faqs.a: Yes — share priorities and we customize the day.

culture-coffee-ceremony-tour.title: Culture & Coffee Ceremony Tour
culture-coffee-ceremony-tour.summary: Taste Ethiopia’s coffee culture and sample Addis Ababa’s living traditions.
culture-coffee-ceremony-tour.description: Coffee is at the heart of Ethiopian hospitality. This tour blends city culture stops with a traditional coffee ceremony experience — relaxed, social, and memorable.

itinerary.text: Short city orientation near Meskel Square.
Sit for a traditional coffee ceremony with your guide.
Time for questions and hotel return.

faqs.a: Tell us ahead — snacks with the ceremony can often be adjusted.
